<edits>
No components changed. All candidates (inv1, dom1, agg1) used identical harness code (745ba24861) with matching system.md and task.md prompts as the base harness. Each harness.diff shows "(no change)". The execution variation across rollouts—token counts ranging from 2591 to 3408 tokens, and final answers varying between C and G—resulted from model stochasticity on the same unchanged harness, not from harness edits. All four rollouts (base1, inv1, dom1, agg1) delivered successfully with one LLM call following an identical execution path: load system prompt, format task prompt with the question, invoke the LLM, and return stripped reply.
</edits>
